description:
Outcome: Gardener applies for coming season and coordinator reviews applications (brief.md: First version must 1–2).
Scope: Zero to three distinct ordered valid plot preferences, one application per household/season, immutable submitted_at, confirmation, coordinator list and pre-allocation edits preserving order. Excludes: payments.
Acceptance: Own application saved/reloaded; >3, duplicate or invalid preferences rejected; repeated/concurrent submit yields one application; coordinator sees timestamp, preferences and prior-holder status.
Behaviour: Closed/wrong season explained; owner/coordinator access only. Large text and plain language; phone layout, labelled controls, keyboard/focus support and explicit empty/loading/error/success states. Preserve input on failure and permit retries without duplicate writes; enforce permissions on server.
Verification: Preference boundaries, duplicate/race, access tests and phone application walkthrough. Prerequisites: T-004, T-005. Assumptions: preferences optional/advisory; coming season configured by coordinator.
title: Submit and review seasonal applications
